conditional_adjustment.annulus_status: Arithmetic only: requires actual pad etch/registration process confirmation; ±0.075 hole position is not a separate drill-to-copper guarantee. JLC recommendation multilayer1oz0.20, absolute0.15, not an RF launch rule.
conditional_adjustment.solder_fit: Larger holes increase solder volume; joint fill, wetting, pin retention, thermal relief and vibration remain unqualified. Do not classify arithmetic PASS as process qualification.

projection.equation: PbelowB = Llead - tBoard - sF; positive sF lifts connector, reduces projection. AboveF =9.73+sF.
projection.soldered_extent_equation: Bside = max(2.90-sF, fB); Fside=max(9.73+sF,fF). fB/fF are actual solder fillet extents relative to board surfaces.
projection.missing: No published maximum solder fillet or trim allowance. No fabricated numeric soldered maximum. Keep B-side body/tool recipe parametric and qualify actual assembly before final packing.
